rawText:
Based on my analysis, the decision lives in the renderer's `unmount()` (keep-alive flag → deactivate/detach vs. real unmount) plus the KeepAlive component's cache-pruning logic (per cached branch: keep, detach, or remove outright), in both the runtime-core and runtime-vapor implementations.

```json
[
  {"path": "packages/runtime-core/src/renderer.ts", "from_line": 2413, "to_line": 2425, "why": "In unmount(), the COMPONENT_SHOULD_KEEP_ALIVE shapeFlag check is the central decision: a keep-alive'd branch is detached into the KeepAlive storage container via ctx.deactivate() and returned, otherwise it falls through to being truly unmounted (removed outright)."},
  {"path": "packages/runtime-core/src/components/KeepAlive.ts", "from_line": 239, "to_line": 252, "why": "onBeforeUnmount iterates every cached branch when the KeepAlive itself is unmounting and decides per branch: the current one gets its keep-alive flag reset so it unmounts as part of keep-alive's own unmount (kept in the flow, deactivated hook fired), while all other cached branches are unmounted outright."},
  {"path": "packages/runtime-core/src/components/KeepAlive.ts", "from_line": 189, "to_line": 200, "why": "pruneCacheEntry decides per cached entry whether to fully unmount it (removed outright) or, for the current entry, just reset its keep-alive flag so it is kept for a later unmount."},
  {"path": "packages/runtime-core/src/components/KeepAlive.ts", "from_line": 521, "to_line": 557, "why": "deactivate() implements the 'detach' option: it moves the cached vnode into the hidden storage container with MoveType.LEAVE and marks the instance deactivated so the branch is kept alive rather than destroyed."},
  {"path": "packages/runtime-core/src/components/KeepAlive.ts", "from_line": 168, "to_line": 173, "why": "The local unmount() helper resets the keep-alive shape flag before delegating to the renderer's real _unmount, which is the concrete 'removed outright' path for cached branches."},
  {"path": "packages/runtime-core/src/components/KeepAlive.ts", "from_line": 453, "to_line": 457, "why": "resetShapeFlag clears COMPONENT_SHOULD_KEEP_ALIVE and COMPONENT_KEPT_ALIVE, the mechanism that converts a kept branch into one that will be fully unmounted instead of re-deactivated."},
  {"path": "packages/runtime-vapor/src/components/KeepAlive.ts", "from_line": 336, "to_line": 372, "why": "Vapor's onBeforeUnmount makes the same per-cached-branch decision when a KeepAlive unmounts: deactivate the current branch, unset the flag and remove every other cached branch outright."},
  {"path": "packages/runtime-vapor/src/components/KeepAlive.ts", "from_line": 287, "to_line": 303, "why": "Vapor's pruneCacheEntry decides per cached branch whether to remove it outright or just unset its keep-alive flag, stopping the branch's scope in the process."},
  {"path": "packages/runtime-vapor/src/components/KeepAlive.ts", "from_line": 628, "to_line": 654, "why": "Vapor's deactivate() performs the detach by moving the branch into the storage container with MoveType.LEAVE and marking it deactivated."}
]
```
